CustomObject.label: WhatsApp Session
CustomObject.description: Maps WhatsApp phone numbers to Agentforce Agent API session IDs. Used by the WhatsApp webhook handler to maintain conversation continuity.

fields.label: Phone Number
fields.description: The WhatsApp phone number (including country code, no + prefix). This is the unique key for session lookup.

fields.label: Agent Session ID
fields.description: The session ID returned by the Agentforce Agent API when a new session was created.

fields.label: Last Sequence ID
fields.description: Tracks the message sequence number for the Agent API. Each message in a session must have an incrementing sequence ID.

fields.label: Last Activity
fields.description: When the last message was processed for this session. Used to determine if the session has expired (30-minute timeout).
